Vendored third-party JS
=======================

Self-hosted to avoid external CDN dependency in restricted-network
environments and to dodge Chrome Opaque Response Blocking on unpkg.com.

Refresh versions by re-downloading with the `@` URL-encoded as `%40`
(plain `@` confuses curl's URL parser):

  curl -sL -o alpine-3.13.5.min.js "https://unpkg.com/alpinejs%403.13.5/dist/cdn.min.js"
  curl -sL -o htmx-1.9.12.min.js   "https://unpkg.com/htmx.org%401.9.12/dist/htmx.min.js"

File                      Version   Source                                            License
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
alpine-3.13.5.min.js      3.13.5    https://github.com/alpinejs/alpine                MIT
htmx-1.9.12.min.js        1.9.12    https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx            BSD-2-Clause

Both licenses permit redistribution without attribution in-tree; the
source repos carry the authoritative license files.
